title: iom857's Advancements
body:
## Adds new Advancements! 
That minecraft is currently missing like:

### Planting specific crops,

Advancement: Were a nightshade... (plant a potato on a farmland)

Advancement: Healthy for your eyes!... (plant a carrot on a farmland)

### Getting specific tools,

Advancement: Diamond Pick!!! (Obtain a diamond pickaxe)

Advancement: Diamond Warrior(Obtain a diamond axe)

Older versions (behind 1.21.1 )may not work because the code isn't the same as the later versions.(tabs may be bugged)
